prompts.text: Pitch a startup so absurd it just might work. One line.
Invent a fake startup that disrupts something that shouldn't be disrupted.
Create a startup idea for AI that solves an imaginary problem.
Pitch a food delivery startup with a terrible twist.
Invent a fake SaaS product with a name that's a pun.
Pitch a startup for a market of exactly one person.
Create a fake crypto project with a silly name.
Invent a startup that automates something you love doing manually.
Pitch a coworking space with a bizarre theme.
Invent a fake productivity startup that promises the opposite.
Create a startup that charges people for free things.
Pitch a fake social network for an unusual community.
